jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager (Contractor)
jobs.description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in...
 
The Contractor shall provide the following services on an independent, deliverables basis, exercising their own professional judgment, expertise, and methods in performing the Services.

In this role, you can expect to:
User Acquisition, Re-Engagement, and Retargeting

- Develop and deliver multi-channel acquisition and retargeting strategies across mobile and PC platforms, tailored to market and audience segmentation, and provide execution plans for Client's review and approval.

- Independently execute and optimize campaigns across advertising platforms (e.g., Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, DSPs, influencer channels) within budgets approved by Client, with the objective of achieving target CPI, ROAS, and LTV benchmarks.

- Apply mobile measurement partner tools (e.g., AppsFlyer) and SKAN 4.0 frameworks to test, measure, and scale iOS campaign performance, and deliver findings and recommendations to Client.

- Deliver attribution analysis, reporting tools, and identification of data gaps in coordination with Client's data resources; provide reporting on channel contribution, LTV projections, and funnel performance.

- Design and deliver structured A/B testing plans across channels, campaign variables, and audiences, and provide results-based recommendations for efficiency improvements.

ASO and Creative Strategy

- Develop, execute, and deliver an ASO strategy and testing plan across app storefronts, including data-driven A/B tests for metadata, keywords, and visual assets.

- Deliver creative strategy recommendations that align paid acquisition campaigns with store page experiences to support growth objectives.

- Prepare creative briefs and deliver project plans for creative asset pipelines, from concept through final delivery, for Client's review.

- Coordinate with Client's internal creative resources and manage relationships with third-party vendors (e.g., creative production studios, ASO agencies) engaged by the Contractor or approved by Client, as needed to complete deliverables.

Cross-Functional Deliverables

- Provide strategic input aligning UA and creative deliverables with Client's product roadmap and live operations, based on information provided by Client's game/product resources.

- Provide ROI assessments and creative alignment recommendations in coordination with Client's marketing, branding, and insights resources.

- Provide channel performance evaluations and LTV validation analysis in coordination with Client's data and finance resources, to inform marketing execution against agreed business metrics.

- Maintain current knowledge of industry trends, platform policy changes (e.g., Apple/Google privacy requirements), and emerging growth technologies, and incorporate relevant developments into deliverables at the Contractor's discretion.
To be successful in this role, your background includes:
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

- 3+ years of hands-on growth marketing/UA experience, with a proven track record in mobile gaming or free-to-play app environments.

- Expertise working directly inside self-serve ad platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, DSPs) and Mobile Measurement Partners (MMP, specifically AppsFlyer). Deep understanding of SKAN 4.0 measurement is required.

- Experience running ASO test plans (App Store Connect, Google Play Console, or third-party ASO tools) and managing creative briefing/vendor workflows.

- Strong data analysis skills; ability to design A/B tests, interpret complex funnel data, and extract actionable insights to optimize campaign spend.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting campaign results and performance narratives to cross-functional stakeholders.

- Strong analytical and data-driven mindset.
Excited by this opportunity? Kabam is dedicated to growing our diverse and inclusive workforce, so if your past experience doesn’t perfectly match the listed requirements we encourage you to apply anyways - you could be a great fit for this or other positions.

We invite you to apply now and start the conversation with us. Together, we can create and support some of the best games ever made and entertain the world!

About Kabam

Kabam is a world leader in developing entertaining, immersive, and highly social multiplayer games, bringing high-quality graphics, next-generation technology, and revolutionary gameplay to players around the world.

Kabam’s games, Marvel Contest of Champions, Shop Titans, and more have generated hundreds of millions of downloads and have received multiple awards including Apple’s Editor’s Choice and Google Play’s Best Game of the Year.

Founded in 2006, Kabam has studios and offices in Vancouver & Montreal in Canada, and Los Angeles & San Francisco in the United States. Kabam is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Netmarble Games.

Kabam is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and equitable workplace, and inclusive environment for all existing and potential employees. Employment decisions are based on candidate qualifications and business need, not race, color, ancestry, place of origin, age, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, political belief, religion, creed, marital or family status, medical condition, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, prior criminal conviction or any other protected class in accordance with federal, state or provincial and local laws and ordinances. jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, ASO (Contract)
jobs.description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in...
 
Reporting to the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, the Growth Marketing Manager, ASO (Contract) will unify ASO strategy and execution into a single point of contact to ensure streamlined strategy and execution. This role is critical for driving organic growth for live service titles like MCoC and Shop Titans, while leading the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for upcoming new title launches.

In this role, you can expect to:
ASO Strategy & Execution

- Roadmap Management: Develop the ASO roadmap, balancing default page optimizations with a robust A/B testing schedule of 3–5 tests per month per game.

- Semantic Optimization: Develop strategy and execution to align with ongoing platform changes driven by AI.

- AI-Driven Workflows: Utilize generative AI tools to scale high-volume metadata creation, localize for target markets, and perform sentiment analysis on competitor reviews.

- Storefront Operations: Lead end-to-end execution across iOS, Google Play, Epic, and Steam, including uploading assets and managing storefront asset sheets.

- Creative & Keyword Optimization: Collaborate with Creative Services (CS) to brief and iterate on high-impact assets like icons, screenshots, and feature graphics.

- Launch Readiness (New Title): Lead ASO requirements for new game preparation, including soft launch testing roadmaps and post-launch optimization.

- QA & Compliance: Review all store pages before submission and act as the final sign-off for the PRM release gate.
Technical & Social Health: Monitor app store trends, competitor strategies, and algorithm changes to maintain visibility rankings.

Platform Marketing & Event Cards

- Strategy Consulting: Advise on platform best practices for App Event Cards across the portfolio to optimize performance, partnering closely with PMM and Creative Services (CS).

- Execution: Support Product Marketing in areas that are needed such as (but not limited to) execution, including copywriting, creative ideation/project management, etc.

- Cross-Functional: If necessary, coordinate with PMM, PRM, CS, and BD to align ASO efforts with game calendars and platforms featuring opportunities.

- Maintenance: Maintain the Platform Event Card Mastersheet and track performance metrics.

Analysis, Reporting & Synergy

- Holistic Reporting: Monitor ASO KPIs (Impressions, Page Views, Downloads, CVR) and provide weekly/quarterly recaps.

- Stakeholder Reporting: Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance recaps to cross-functional stakeholders.

- Market Intelligence: Conduct thorough keyword research and competitor analysis to identify high-impact optimization opportunities.

- Growth Modeling: Partner with Data Science to build forecasting models and evaluate the business impact of storefront optimizations.

- Behavioral Analysis: Track post-install engagement and retention signals, as the 2026 algorithm increasingly rewards sustained user value over simple download velocity.

- Industry trends: Share ongoing trend updates that are impacting our organic installs and store presence to major stakeholders. Ensure to provide up to date information in real time and insights on how this can impact Kabam’s business.
To be successful in this role, your background includes:
- Experience: 2+ years in Growth Marketing and ASO within the mobile gaming industry.

- Platform Expertise: Deep knowledge of modern app store algorithms, including Apple's NLP intent matching and Google’s AI-organized "Guided Search".

- AI Tooling: Proficiency in AI-specific ASO tools (e.g., AppTweak) and LLMs for workflow efficiency.

- Analytical Skills: Strong data-driven mindset with the ability to build growth models and forecast install impact.

- Project Management: Ability to manage high-volume storefront setups (iOS, Google Play, Epic, Steam) and track all changes meticulously.

jobs.title: Senior People Business Partner
jobs.description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in...

The role of the Senior People Business Partner is to be a trusted advisor, partner and coach with senior leaders at all levels of the organization. The Senior People Business Partner brings a people lens to business decisions  with confidence and sound judgement. This role is built for someone who is comfortable in ambiguity, moves fast, and knows how to turn insight into a drive for results.

This role is a full-time, on-site position based 5 days a week at our Downtown Vancouver studio.
In this role, you can expect to:
Key Accountabilities

Acts as a Strategic Partner:

- Proactively partnering with key stakeholders to identify and support business needs and goals via agile, human-centered, data-driven, innovative approaches.

- Driving Strategic Workforce Planning with senior leaders to bridge business strategy, organizational design, headcount and financial planning, and optimizing performance.

- Leading organizational transformation through change management best practices.

- Demonstrating leadership on all aspects of organizational effectiveness, including performance management, coaching, talent assessment & succession planning, & employee engagement.

- Developing people managers through coaching on leadership effectiveness, performance management, and career development to build a high performance culture.

- Collaborating with people & talent acquisition team members to initiate, project-manage, and execute improvements to programs with change management in mind.

- Driving enhancement in and shaping organizational culture and capability.

Provides Expertise on Employee Relations Matters:

- Acting as a trusted advisor for complex and high-risk employment matters (Canadian and US).

- Guiding and supporting day-to-day employee relations and any acute escalations that may arise.

- Leading and conducting investigations regarding violations of company's standards of conduct.

- Leading and ensuring compliance to employment laws for all terminations, determining legal exposure by verifying applicable legislation and making a recommendation to leadership on how to proceed.

Leads Talent Projects/Programs:

- Leading or contributing in company-wide programs and initiatives (e.g., salary review,  strategic workforce planning, and organizational change).

- Advocating for and influencing new people programs and projects that support business needs.

- Building an understanding of project scope, resource availability, road mapping, and timely stakeholder/cross-functional departmental communication.

Mentors and Coaches:

- Providing mentorship, coaching, and guidance to People Team members, building a strong learning culture on the team.

- Evolving how the PBP team operates, driving consistency in practices and levelling up the impact of team.

- Providing mentorship, executive coaching, and development to senior leaders.

- Building up leadership capabilities across the organization through development plans and high-impact learning opportunities.
To be successful in this role, your background includes:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, industrial relations, commerce or psychology or completion of a professional development program in human resources administration is required.

- Further education in conflict management, coaching, change management.

- PHR/SPHR/CPHR Certification or other industry credentials.

- Certified Coach.

- 8+ years of Human Resources (HR) experience in a project-based, creative culture.

- 3+ years of People Business Partnership experience.

- Experience with an organization going through cultural and business transformation.

- Experience in forging strong partnerships with executive leaders to shape short and long-term People Strategy to drive business strategy and operational goals.

- Experience in working with employees at multi-sites.

- Experience in change management and leading through organizational initiatives and changes.

- Clear and confident communicator who can flex across all levels of the organization.

- Must have strong knowledge of Canadian employment law. Additional knowledge of U.S employment law is an asset.
Our success is due to the hard work of our people. We share our success with our people through flexible benefits and reward programs, sweet swag, snacks, and more. Here’s a look at some of the support we provide our people:
- Extended Health Coverage: effective day one, no waiting period! Our benefits cover health, dental, life, disability, and extended paramedical services such as vision care, mental health practitioners, massage, physiotherapy, acupuncture, and much more.

- DEIB Benefits: DEIB is important to us and to our people - that’s why our benefits include gender-affirming care, fertility care, and other hormonal treatments and drugs.

- Flexible Spending Accounts: our benefits are built on a flex credit model, so you’re able to choose the coverage levels that are right for you, and allocate the rest to a group RRSP/TFSA, Health Spending account, and/or Personal Spending Account.

- RRSP Matching:  everyone retires eventually, and we help our people save for their futures with a contribution matching program once you reach 90 days with us.

- Commuter Benefit: we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, and want to support you in making it work for you! We provide a flexible, monthly cash allowance to help cover the costs of transit, parking, or even personal logistics like childcare and pet care.

- PTO and Parental Leave:  we offer paid parental leave, flexible paid time off, paid time off for volunteering, sick leave, and holiday closures.

- Employee and Family Assistance Program: t his program provides crisis management support, immediate mental health care, and generalized support for emotional, mental, and financial well-being.

- Telus Virtual Health:  we provide increased access to remote healthcare providers for prescription refills or referrals from the comfort of your home.

- Learning and growth:  We encourage people to grow both personally and professionally, and support this through regular lunch & learns and an education stipend.

- Pay transparency: We share with employees the pay range their role falls within and clear career maps to determine how they can grow within their role or level-up to a promotion.

- Cool spaces: Our offices are in Vancouver, Montreal, Los Angeles, and San Francisco. Whether it’s summers on the rooftop patio in Downtown Vancouver, or watching the fireworks in Montreal’s South Shore - we want our people to feel like their time spent in office is worthwhile!

- Giving back: Kabammers have a dedicated paid day off every year to volunteer to a cause close to their hearts. Some teams even band together for group volunteer days off-site!
Excited by this opportunity? Kabam is dedicated to growing our diverse and inclusive workforce, so if your past experience doesn’t perfectly match the listed requirements we encourage you to apply anyways - you could be a great fit for this or other positions.
